name: Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock (a green oak on white beneath a cross and an eagle).
history: Municipal flag of Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock arms — oak beneath cross and eagle
